prompt.zh-TW: 小晴想在月底前讓小山咖啡的「資產總計」變大一些。下列哪一個做法真的會讓資產總計增加？
prompt.en: Ching wants Hillside Coffee's total assets to be a little larger by month end. Which of these would actually increase total assets?

text.zh-TW: 向銀行借一筆短期借款，存進戶頭
text.en: Take out a short-term bank loan and put it in the account

feedback.zh-TW: 說得通。現金增加，同時負債增加，資產總計變大。
feedback.en: This works. Cash rises and so does a liability, so total assets grow.

text.zh-TW: 向豆商賒購一批咖啡豆，下個月再付款
text.en: Buy a batch of beans on credit and pay the supplier next month

feedback.zh-TW: 說得通。存貨增加、應付帳款增加，資產總計同樣變大。
feedback.en: This works too. Inventory rises and trade payables rise, so total assets also grow.

text.zh-TW: 用店裡的現金買一台新的冰箱
text.en: Use cash from the account to buy a new fridge

feedback.zh-TW: 現金變少、設備變多，只是資產之間互換，資產總計不變。
feedback.en: Cash goes down and equipment goes up: one asset is swapped for another, and total assets stay the same.

text.zh-TW: 用現金付清欠豆商的貨款
text.en: Pay the supplier what is owed, in cash

feedback.zh-TW: 付款之後現金減少、應付帳款也減少，資產總計反而變小。
feedback.en: After paying, cash falls and trade payables fall as well, so total assets actually shrink.

explanation.zh-TW: 要讓資產總計變大，右邊的負債或股東權益也要一起變大。{{option:o_f3c9}}與{{option:o_fa6g}}都是資產與負債同時增加，所以選哪一個都算對；{{option:o_92dv}}只是資產互換，{{option:o_6rmj}}則讓兩邊一起縮小。
explanation.en: For total assets to grow, liabilities or equity on the other side must grow too. {{option:o_f3c9}} and {{option:o_fa6g}} both raise an asset and a liability together, so either is correct. {{option:o_92dv}} only swaps one asset for another, and {{option:o_6rmj}} shrinks both sides.
